description.narrative: This project aims to make concrete plans for the strengthening of our partnership for the future. We wish to discuss our past activities within the partnership to identify key learning points, which will be the basis of the partnership work plan - our main goal with the project. Within this, feedback from our recent monitoring from DUF, will be discussed and included. Challenges with visa applications have occurred within our most recent projects, and this is a challenge we need to prepare our partnership to face in the future, to ensure that our partnership prevails non the less, why these will be discussed with the goal being to make concrete back-up plans for future challenges of this sort. Lastly, we will also take into consideration how to ensure transparency and involvement of new members in both organisations going forward, as part of the workplan for the future. These activities will take place over approx. five days of workshops, with volunteer members and key staff - both old and new - from both organisations.
